sources.title: Nadakacheri Citizen Service Prerequisite & Document Verification Guidelines
sources.authority: Directorate of Atalji Janasnehi Kendra, Government of Karnataka
sources.review_notes: Official citizen guidelines for Income and Caste certificate applications at Atalji Janasnehi Kendra citizen service counters.

chunks.chunk_text: Applicants visiting the citizen service centre for Income Certificate processing must present an original government-approved photo identity proof. Approved identity documents include: (1) Aadhaar card issued by UIDAI, or (2) Elector Photo Identity Card (EPIC / Voter ID) issued by the Election Commission of India. Photocopies must be accompanied by the original document for physical counter verification.

In addition to identity proof, applicants must provide residential verification. Acceptable address documents include: an active Domicile or Residential Certificate issued by the Revenue Department, a valid Ration Card (BPL or APL), or an electricity utility bill issued within the preceding 6 months in the name of the applicant or head of family.

chunks.section_heading: 3. Office Working Hours and Counter Operations
chunks.chunk_text: Citizen service centres operate Monday through Friday between 9:30 AM and 5:30 PM IST, excluding notified public holidays. Applicants holding scheduled appointment tokens must report to the helpdesk counter 10 minutes prior to their assigned time slot. Counter token processing fees must be settled exclusively at authorized departmental counters.
